**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

The agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier covenant binding Sparkling:

- **§2 (Grant of Licence, p0028):** "non-transferable and non-exclusive licence" — this limits the scope of Garman's licence grant to us; it is not a purchasing restriction on us.
- **§3 (Restrictions on Use):** copying, assignment, sublicence and reverse-engineering limits only — no restriction on procuring competing software or services.
- **§10–11 (Maintenance and Fees):** obligations run to Garman to supply Maintenance Services; our only obligation is to pay the Fee Schedule. Nothing requires us to source routing software, maintenance or support solely from Garman.
- Other "exclusive" hits are benign: escrow licence (p0115, non-exclusive, in our favour), exclusive-remedy clause (§15), and non-exclusive jurisdiction (p0146).
- Targeted searches for "sole", "solely from", "requirements from", "competing", "other supplier" and "exclusivity" returned no exclusive-dealing language.

We retain full freedom to buy from other suppliers, which meets the playbook's preferred position, so no amendment is proposed.
